research.title: Forests in the IPCC Special Report on Land Use: 7 Things to Know
research.note: Explains why deforestation and forest carbon sinks are two sides of the same coin; maps directly to Canopy's clear/preserve tension.

research.title: How Effective Is Land At Removing Carbon Pollution? The IPCC Weighs In
research.note: Real reforestation carbon-removal potential; grounds the "replanting works, just slower" hope angle in actual IPCC figures.

research.title: Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry (LULUCF)
research.note: The formal policy framework for tracking forest carbon sinks internationally; why Canopy treats plots as carbon-relevant assets, not scenery.

research.title: Deforestation & Reforestation
research.note: Accessible overview with links to real reforestation organizations, for players who want to go from facts to action.
